record.body:
## Description

R7: Task payloads used to build the graph include depends_on task ids sufficient to draw edges without per-task detail fetches.

## Approach

Add `depends_on: tuple[str, ...]` (task record ids) to model `TaskRow` and populate from relationships when building rows. Ensure phase detail / snapshot JSON exposes it via existing jsonable. Python test asserts enriched ids.

payload.title: Enrich task JSON with depends_on ids
